description: Build, archive, and export a signed .ipa via xcodebuild (requires Xcode on this Mac). Needs a scheme and an ExportOptions.plist. Projects generated by xcodegen or tuist must be generated first: pass pre_build_command. Returns the .ipa this export produced. Pro feature.

output_dir.description: Output directory (default ./build). Each export goes into its own export-<timestamp> folder inside it.

pre_build_command.description: Command to run first in the project's folder, as an argument array without a shell, e.g. ["xcodegen","generate"] or ["tuist","generate","--no-open"]. Required for generated projects.

workspace.description: Set true if project_path is a .xcworkspace

name: build_and_archive
title: Build and archive with Xcode
